title: What an agentic workflow is
caption: Working definition for this Episode: agents take some decisions and actions inside a path people set. This combines vendor descriptions; it is not universal. You design the path; the agent steers inside its task.

ibm-wording.description: “Agentic workflows are AI-driven processes where autonomous AI agents make decisions, take actions and coordinate tasks with minimal human intervention.” [1]

ibm-agentic-workflows.title: Gutowska and Stryker (IBM), What are Agentic Workflows?

salesforce-wording.description: “Agentic workflows are structured processes where AI agents make decisions, solve problems, and perform tasks with minimal human input.” The word “structured” is Salesforce's; “coordinate tasks” is IBM's. The Slide's sentence merges the two and belongs to neither vendor [1].

why-vendors-stress-autonomy.description: Both sell agent platforms and praise reduced oversight; that this explains their wording is an inference, the pages give no reason [1].

ibm-agentic-workflows.title: Gutowska and Stryker (IBM), What are Agentic Workflows?

two-levels-of-control.description: Anthropic draws the line at who controls the steps: workflows are orchestrated through predefined code paths, agents direct their own process. Applying “you design the path, the agent steers inside its task” to a team's process is an inference [1].

autonomy-as-a-degree.description: Ng prefers to call systems agent-like to different degrees, with a gray zone, over a binary [1].

ng-the-batch-253.title: Andrew Ng, The Batch issue 253 (letter on agentic workflows)

the-definition.title: The definition
the-definition.script: For this Episode, an agentic workflow is a process where agents take some decisions and actions inside a path people set. That is a working definition informed by vendor descriptions, not a universal standard. The exact sources are in the Speaker notes.

two-levels.title: Two levels
two-levels.script: Read it as two levels. You design the path: the tasks and what each hands over to the next. The agent steers inside its own task. How much oversight each task gets is a separate choice, not something the definition settles.

minimal-how-minimal.title: Minimal, how minimal
minimal-how-minimal.script: Notice the phrase minimal human intervention: it carries a lot of weight but does not say how much or for which task. Here, people sign off twice. The next Section looks at how oversight can be chosen task by task.
